turns.assessment: The outage is a simultaneous, network-wide optical loss affecting services whose working paths all depend on roadm.S01. Concurrent AMP_INPUT_LOS on multiple lines leaving S01 indicates channels are being blocked within S01 rather than a failure of one downstream span or amplifier. A failed WSS input port explains loss of all channels arriving on that degree and their disappearance across multiple outgoing degrees; client, line-card, OTN-switch, and single-span faults do not match this footprint.

proposals.rationale: All affected working paths share roadm.S01, and simultaneous optical-loss alarms appear downstream on multiple S01 outgoing lines. This is the documented signature of an S01 WSS input-port failure blocking all channels arriving on one degree while leaving unrelated traffic unaffected.

clarify.assessment: The evidence localizes the failure to an S01 WSS input port, but it does not uniquely identify the incoming degree. Losses on multiple S01 outgoing lines establish downstream impact, while the available unchanged measurements do not discriminate among the five candidate input ports. Selecting one would risk an unsupported repair.

llm_alone.decision: commit not to one place (5 locations); reported as a set

score.why: truth not in the reported set
